# Draft:Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Village Bride

Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Village Bride is the third limited series under the Star Wars: Visions Presents branding, a spinoff of the animated television series Star Wars: Visions. The series will continue the story of the short films "The Village Bride" from Volume 1 and "The Lost Ones" from Volume 3, which were written by Takahito Oonishi & Hitoshi Haga and produced by Kinema Citrus.
